python:cpython@3.14.4.note: CPython 3.14.4 (PSF-2.0), python-build-standalone 20260414, the build uv 0.11.11 installs on Linux for .python-version 3.14. SQLite 3.50.4 (public domain) and xz 5.8.1 (0BSD) need no notice. Berkeley DB 6.0.19 (Sleepycat) and Tcl/Tk 9.0.3 link only into the _dbm and _tkinter modules, which the compiled server does not include. Source: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/tag/20260414
